# AI tool coverage — operation inventory

<!-- GENERATED by crates/openframe-application/tests/ai_tool_coverage.rs from the live Registry.
     Do not edit by hand: run `cargo test -p openframe-application --test ai_tool_coverage`. -->

Every registered operation carries explicit `OperationMetadata` (agentic spec §39). The assistant
never names registry operations: it chooses **tools**. Read tools answer from canonical data with the
user's permissions; proposal tools only build a Change Set that a person reviews and applies
(spec §3, §7, §40). Operations whose UI asks for an extra destructive confirmation keep asking for it
in the Proposed Changes card.

How the toolbox (`modules/ai/toolbox.rs`, contract C3) enforces this:

- `tools_for` offers read tools to anyone with View, and a proposal tool only when the actor holds its
  capability **and** ApplyChangeSet and every operation it uses is registered and exposed here. No tool
  reviews, accepts or applies a Change Set, and no tool touches an `ai.*` operation.
- `run_tool` re-checks everything (the offered list is not the boundary): unknown tool → `ai.unknown_tool`;
  arguments are validated against the tool's strict schema (closed objects, bounded strings/lists/numbers,
  8 KB total) → `ai.tool_arguments`; missing permission → `permission.denied`.
- Proposal tools resolve references (names, scene/shot/panel numbers, "Day 3") to rows, never guess
  between several matches (`ai.ambiguous` asks one question), record base revisions for stale detection,
  and return a `ChangeSetDraft`. Every built draft is re-validated: only listed, exposed, registered commands.
- Read tools are bounded (pages of ≤ 80 items, clipped text) and read through the caller's connection.
  Another user's private notes are never visible (owner filter on every lookup, search and retrieval).
- `tools_for_request` picks the core tools plus the request-relevant domain tools within a character
  budget, so a small local model's prompt stays short. `retrieve_context` uses the hybrid retrieval
  service when called through `run_tool_unlocked`, and keyword retrieval (FTS5, same privacy rule) otherwise.

- Registered operations: **423** (124 queries, 299 commands)
- Exposed to the assistant through tools: **298**; not AI-accessible: **125**
- Tools: **251** (58 read/compute/navigate, 193 proposal)

Flags: **D** destructive · **I** irreversible · **C** extra UI confirmation · **L** long-running (task id) · file effect: R = reads a user-picked file, W = writes to a user-picked location, P = project storage on disk.

| `visual.vault_images` — Idea Vault images available to place on a moodboard (project or Global Idea Vault). | query | Read | View |  | `VaultImagesArgs` → `Vec<VaultImageRef>` | hidden | — |

## Not AI-accessible, and why

- **Adds media the user supplies (picked image files or pasted image data); the assistant cannot supply media.**
  `cast.set_photo`, `catalog.set_image`, `locations.add_photos`, `moodboard.add_image_data`, `moodboard.add_images`, `shot.set_reference_image`, `story.set_character_image`, `storyboard.set_panel_visual`, `vault.ingest_bytes`
- **Alternative UI entry point for a change the assistant already prepares through an equivalent operation.**
  `breakdown.accept`, `shot.attach_panel`, `shot.detach_panel`, `vault.restore`, `vault.trash_list`
- **Application-level project lifecycle (create, open, close, locate, duplicate, archive or delete projects on disk, recent-project list); the assistant works inside the one open project.**
  `project.close`, `project.create`, `project.current`, `project.duplicate`, `project.list_recent`, `project.open`, `project.recovery_state`, `project.remove_recent`, `project.rename`, `project.resolve_recovery`, `project.set_archived`, `project.set_pinned`
- **Crosses the project boundary (Global Idea Vault or another project); the assistant is scoped to the open project.**
  `templates.copy`, `vault.copy_to_store`
- **Data for an interactive dialog or editor preview; the assistant reads the same facts through its own bounded tools.**
  `app.save_state`, `history.info`, `interchange.draft_scenes`, `interchange.export_preview`, `interchange.sources`, `moodboard.suggestions`, `packages.backup_preview`, `packages.exchange_preview`, `packages.exchange_scenes`, `packages.exchange_sources`, `tasks.relatable_types`, `vault.story_targets`, `visual.vault_images`
- **Exchange and review packages bring other people's changes in from package files; opening, reviewing and applying them stays a human workflow.**
  `packages.apply_import`, `packages.cancel_import`, `packages.open_exchange`, `packages.queue_attach`, `packages.record_view`, `packages.review_comment`, `packages.review_delete_comment`, `packages.review_get`, `packages.review_list`, `packages.session`, `packages.session_view`, `packages.undo_import`
- **Human-only approval boundary: accepting, rejecting or re-checking a Change Set is a user action in the review card (spec §7, §40).**
  `ai.change_set.accept`, `ai.change_set.get`, `ai.change_set.recheck`, `ai.change_set.reject`
- **Immediate session control (undo/redo, save, cancel a running task, display name) stays a direct user action; an applied Change Set is itself one undo step.**
  `app.cancel_task`, `app.set_display_name`, `history.redo`, `history.undo`, `project.save`
- **Internal maintenance with no user-visible project change.**
  `ai.index_rebuild`, `ai.index_status`, `search.rebuild`
- **Keeping or dismissing a schedule warning is the user's own judgement in the warning dialog ("Keep Anyway"); proposals never pre-accept warnings.**
  `schedule.decide_warning`
- **Keystroke-level screenplay editor primitive (batched typing, element moves/splits); the assistant proposes scene-level changes instead.**
  `screenplay.apply_edits`, `screenplay.merge_scene`, `screenplay.move_element`, `screenplay.split_scene`
- **Manual visual arrangement (drag position, size, stacking order) with no content meaning; the user arranges directly.**
  `locations.move_photo`, `moodboard.arrange_item`, `moodboard.move_items`, `moodboard.reorder`, `moodboard.resize_item`
- **Offline AI installation and runtime management is the user's decision in Settings, not something the assistant does to itself.**
  `ai.cancel_install`, `ai.diagnostics`, `ai.install`, `ai.setup_info`, `ai.status`, `ai.stop_runtime`, `ai.uninstall`
- **Owner-only override of a lock or finalization; it stays a deliberate human action.**
  `screenplay.unlock_draft`
- **Per-user view state (collapsed rows, remembered positions, current episode); not project content.**
  `project.set_last_location`, `screenplay.set_view_state`, `screenplay.view_state`, `story.set_collapsed`, `story.set_current_episode`, `story.view_state`
- **Permanent deletion ('Delete forever') is never offered to the assistant (spec §28); items stay in Recently Deleted.**
  `packages.record_delete`, `project.delete`, `trash.purge`, `vault.purge`
- **Reads or writes a file-system location the user picks in a file dialog; the assistant never chooses or touches file-system paths (spec §3).**
  `breakdown.export_report`, `budget.export_summary`, `callsheets.attach`, `callsheets.export_pdf`, `files.add`, `files.export_copy`, `files.relink`, `moodboard.export_pdf`, `packages.create_backup`, `packages.export_exchange`, `packages.export_project`, `packages.import_project`, `packages.inspect_package`, `packages.review_export_response`, `packages.review_open`, `project.locate`, `reports.export_report`, `schedule.export_schedule`, `screenplay.export`, `screenplay.import_apply`, `screenplay.import_preview`, `shot.export_list`, `sides.export_pdf`, `story.add_attachment`, `story.export_board`, `storyboard.export_sheet`, `vault.add_files`, `vault.relink`
- **Returns local file paths of managed media; the assistant never receives file-system paths.**
  `app.info`, `files.asset`
- **The assistant's own entry point and conversation history; a tool calling it would recurse.**
  `ai.ask`, `ai.history`
